unit.title: Time
unit.blurb: Finding time intervals in hours and minutes using 12-hour and 24-hour clocks and timetables, and comparing times in different time zones.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Find time intervals in seconds, minutes and hours, using 12- and 24-hour clocks and timetables.

O2.t: Understand time zones and work out the time in another place.

p: To find how long something takes, **count on** in steps to the next hour, then whole hours, then the minutes left.
From 10:35 to 13:10: 25 min to 11:00, 2 hours to 13:00, 10 min to 13:10 → **2 hours 35 minutes**.
There are 60 minutes in an hour, so 1:45 + 30 minutes is 2:15, not 1:75.

p: The world is split into **time zones**. When it is midday in London it is **7 p.m. in Hanoi** (7 hours ahead) and **7 a.m. in New York** (5 hours behind).
To find the time in another place, **add** hours if it is ahead and **subtract** hours if it is behind.
Ahead means later in the day: add hours. Behind means earlier: subtract.
